components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; font-family: Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.0625rem; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #16191b; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #000; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2c200; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Enamel Plate
components.description: White sign plate with stamped inner border and screw heads; holds headlines and boards.
components.html: Il pedigree prima di tutto.
components.css: .ds-field { background: #0e6b3a; padding: 32px; } .ds-plate { position: relative; background: #fff; color: #16191b; border-radius: 10px; padding: 40px 32px 32px; box-shadow: 0 2px 3px rgb(6 38 20 / 0.35), 0 10px 24px -8px rgb(6 38 20 / 0.45), inset 0 0 0 3px #fff, inset 0 0 0 5px #16191b; font-family: Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-plate h2 { margin: 0; font-weight: 900; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-plate::before, .ds-plate::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 12px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #cfd6d1, #7d877f); } .ds-plate::before { left: 12px; } .ds-plate::after { right: 12px; }

components.name: Arrow Plate
components.description: Pointed plate for anything that leads somewhere: steps, intents, species links.
components.html: CaniPedigree ENCI, LOI e LOR
components.css: .ds-field { background: #0e6b3a; padding: 32px; } .ds-arrow { display: inline-grid; gap: 2px; min-width: 280px; background: #fff; color: #16191b; text-decoration: none; font-family: Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 20px 48px 20px 24px; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 32px) 0, 100% 50%, calc(100% - 32px) 100%, 0 100%); filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 2px rgb(6 38 20 / 0.35)) drop-shadow(0 10px 14px rgb(6 38 20 / 0.3)); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-arrow:hover { transform: translateX(6px); } .ds-arrow:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2c200; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-arrow strong { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-arrow span { color: #46504a; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Signpost Plate
components.description: Signature profile plate with yellow tip; active state shows the blaze and a red km figure.
components.css: .ds-field { background: #0e6b3a; padding: 32px; } .ds-sign { position: relative; width: 400px; max-width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 80px; padding: 10px 60px 10px 20px; border: 0; background: #fff; color: #16191b; font-family: Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 40px) 0, 100% 50%, calc(100% - 40px) 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-sign::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; right: 0; width: 22px; background: #f2c200; } .ds-sign:hover:not([aria-pressed='true']) { background: #f3f7f4; } .ds-sign:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f2c200; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-main { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 900; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-breed { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-wants { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #46504a; } .ds-km { display: grid; text-align: right; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-km b { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; } .ds-sign[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-km b { color: #d52b1e; } .ds-km span { color: #46504a; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
Every match is a trail sign: breed, purpose and kilometres toward another pedigree animal. The page is a park-sign green field. Content sits on white enamel plates lettered in heavy black, and the plates that point somewhere are cut as arrows. The system borrows the material honesty of Italian mountain signage: few colours, each with one job, flat graphic objects with a little real weight under them.

Density is low and confident. Large green regions carry the page; plates are the only containers. One 8px module sizes every plate, gap and padding, so a plate on the signpost, a step on the trail and the waitlist form read as the same object at different scales. Motion is reserved for one authored moment: a plate turning on the post as a match lands.

This is the owners' format. The breeders' "Ring d'expo" format (show-ring rosettes, armband numbers) is a future variant held in PRODUCT.md; it is not part of this system and nothing here should anticipate it.

The static pages under `public/` (blog, specie, enciclopedia, matches, offline) predate this system and are pending migration. Do not derive tokens or patterns from them.
keyCharacteristics: Green field, white enamel plates, black lettering; nothing else carries large area.
Arrow-shaped plates for anything that points: links, steps, intents, the form.
CAI red-white-red blaze only on the active match.
Trail-sign yellow only on arrow tips, focus and selection.
Overpass at weight 900 for every heading.

rules.name: The Blaze Rule
rules.body: Blaze red marks the active match and nothing else. If a screen has no active match, it has no blaze.

rules.name: The Hardware Rule
rules.body: Yellow and pole grey are sign hardware, not palette. They never fill a section or a content plate, and never carry text; the nav CTA's yellow hover is the one plate-sized use.

rules.name: The Lettering Rule
rules.body: Every h1 to h3 is Overpass 900, line-height 1.02, -0.02em, balanced wrap. Hierarchy comes from size, never from a second face or a lighter weight.

rules.name: The Drawn Dot Rule
rules.body: Inline separators are a drawn 4px dot, not a typed middot; Overpass sets the middot too high.

rules.name: The Green Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted with the field's own dark green, never neutral black.

rules.name: The Arrow Means Direction Rule
rules.body: A plate is cut as an arrow only when it leads somewhere or represents a step along the way. Status (pedigree caricato, verificato) is a pill, because a badge reports what was checked; it does not point.

dos: Do size every gap, padding and plate dimension from the 8px module.
Do put content on white enamel or arrow plates; let the green field carry the space between them.
Do cut a plate as an arrow when it leads somewhere or marks a step; keep status as a pill.
Do label synthetic profiles as examples ("profili di esempio").
Do keep secondary text on green in the tinted soft green at 4.5:1 or better.
donts: Don't use blaze red for anything except the active match.
Don't use signpost yellow or pole grey as section or content-plate backgrounds, or as text colours.
Don't introduce a second typeface or set headings below weight 900.
Don't add motion beyond the plate turn and small hover shifts; the turn must have a no-motion fallback.
Don't use neutral black shadows; shadows are field-tinted.
